description: Get what the water is doing right now at a coastal place: the tide's current height and direction, observed wind, water and air temperature, the next 12 hours of wind, active National Weather Service marine and coastal alerts, and daylight. Use for "what are conditions at …", "is it windy at the harbor", "water temperature in …", "any advisories for …". Identify the place with place (a name, optionally with a state), latitude + longitude, or station_id. If a name is not recognised the tool says so: call again with that place's latitude and longitude. Live readings come from the nearest NOAA sensor station and are omitted when none has reported recently. US coasts and territories.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place being asked about, decimal degrees. Use with longitude when a place name is not recognised; approximate is fine.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place, decimal degrees (negative west).

place.description: The coastal place being asked about — a beach, harbor, bay, or town, optionally with a state: "Santa Cruz, CA".

station_id.description: 7-digit NOAA tide station ID, when already known from an earlier result.

units.description: imperial = feet, knots, °F (default). metric = meters, km/h, °C.

name: perigee_get_conditions

perigee.description: perigeetides.com page for the same answer; share it.

summary.description: One or two sentences that answer the question directly.
